name: Black Iron
description: Soot-dark hide, riveted forged iron, bone, and rusted copper.
notes: All layers use a centered 512 x 512 RGBA canvas. Cardinal letters are baked into the fixed riveted ring. The bone spear has 4.19x the opaque mass of the rust-copper wind vane.

orientationConventions.ring: Static north-up forged-iron card. N is baked into the top riveted tab.
orientationConventions.headingPointer: The broad bone spearhead points to 12 o'clock at heading 0. Its iron boss is centered at (0.5, 0.5); rotate it by pure player world bearing.
orientationConventions.windPointer: The slim rust-copper vane points to 12 o'clock at wind bearing 0. Its boss is centered at (0.5, 0.5); rotate it by pure wind-toward world bearing.
orientationConventions.lubberMarker: Optional static top accent for the north index. It does not replace the heading pointer.
